readme: # Global XiaoAI ✨ ### Download - Download from the [releases page](https://github.com/leandropng/GlobalXiaoAI/releases/tag/V1). ### Instructions - Download the zip file and flash it in Magisk or KernelSU. - Reboot your device. - Enjoy! ### Screenshots ### Note - After flashing the module, please update the MiAI apk to the newest version from [MemeOSUpdates](https://memeosupdates.com/apps/com.miui.voiceassist) for it to work. - To change your assistant back to another one, disable the module and remove all XiaoAI apps via [EXA System App Remover](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=exa.free.saux). ### Changelog
readmeHTML:
Global XiaoAI ✨

Download

  • Download from the [releases page](https://github.com/leandropng/GlobalXiaoAI/releases/tag/V1).

    • Instructions

  • Download the zip file and flash it in Magisk or KernelSU.
  • Reboot your device.
  • Enjoy!

    • Screenshots

    Note

  • After flashing the module, please update the MiAI apk to the newest version from [MemeOSUpdates](https://memeosupdates.com/apps/com.miui.voiceassist) for it to work.
  • To change your assistant back to another one, disable the module and remove all XiaoAI apps via [EXA System App Remover](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=exa.free.saux).

    • Changelog
